thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate on inference-serving-prod (svc=runtime, region=us-west-2) — 5xx spike starting ~1778889950. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Escalation level: page.
alice: Acknowledged. On-call here. Seeing 502/504s from the runtime nodes. Rolling window errors ~22%.
bob: I'm looking at frontend gateway logs. Upstream responses showing: "KV cache lookup failed: mismatch seq" and rapid backend retries.
charlie: Pushing into runtime console. Metrics show KV cache miss/hit ratio collapsed and batching latency spiking. Also a recent canary deployment of quantized-q4a on pool-23 at 1778889000.
dave: @alice any customer-facing alerts? We should set status page if >15m impact.
alice: Support, please prepare a short bulletin. @support-bot can you draft? I'll confirm after mitigation.
support-bot: draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates affecting text generation endpoints in us-west-2. Some customers may see increased latency or failures. Engineers are actively mitigating." Please advise edits.
alice: good. Post that once we have mitigation plan. Bob/charlie, what are quick mitigations? Can we fallback to non-quantized model variant?
bob: We can force routing to float16 variant (non-quantized) per policy, but that increases per-token latency ~1.8x. We should do it for affected customers only if necessary.
charlie: Quick win: disable continuous batching for pool-23 to reduce KV pressure and temporarily evict local KV caches to force warm rebuild. I can run commands now.
alice: Do it. Also roll back quantized canary to previous revision if we see consistent correlation.
charlie: Running: ```sh
# evict kv caches on pool-23
redwoodctl runtime evict-kv --pool pool-23 --all
# disable batching
redwoodctl runtime set-batching --pool pool-23 --mode disabled
``` 
charlie: Evict started. Batching disabled. Watching metrics.
bob: Rolling routing policies to float16 for pool-23: ```sh
redwoodctl routing set-variant --pool pool-23 --variant float16 --mode immediate
```  Executed.
alice: Noting customer impact: internal alert shows 7 customers with >= 5% request failures in the last 10min. We should outreach top 3 immediately.
sana: I'll ping AE for the top 3 customers with screenshots and temporary mitigations. @dave can you prepare per-customer logs?
dave: On it. Gathering request ids and sample traces.
charlie: Metrics: KV miss ratio recovering to baseline in ~80s after eviction. Error rate dropping from 22% -> 3% in the last 6 minutes. Batching latency reduced.
bob: Post-routing change, tail latency up for few requests but overall success rate stable. Looks like quantized variant had a cache sync bug when combined with continuous batching + long context.
alice: Good mitigation. Keep batching disabled on pool-23 and keep routing pinned to float16 until we confirm root cause. Schedule a full rollback of the canary and hold future quantization rollouts.
charlie: I opened a temporary incident bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridges/1778889990
support-bot: Status update posted to customers: "Mitigation in progress. Error rates decreasing after configuration changes. Engineering investigation continues."
alice: We'll need a postmortem. Propose slot: 2026-03-17 09:00 PT for a 60min follow-up with runtime, ml, and devex. Who can own?
bob: I can own the postmortem write-up (root cause investigation).
sana: I'll own action items for customer comms and follow-up outreach.
charlie: I'll own remediation tasks tied to runtime (KV cache fixes, batching gating, rollout guardrails).
dave: I'll add automated runbook steps for emergency cache eviction and a runbook test.
alice: Action items summary (assign/ETA):
  - bob: deep-dive root cause + reproduce locally (ETA 2026-03-20)
  - charlie: patch to prevent KV invalidation when quantized variant + batching enabled, add unit/integration tests (ETA 2026-04-01)
  - charlie: add canary gating to block quantization rollout without KV hitrate telemetry (ETA 2026-03-30)
  - dave: automated cache-evict tool + one-click in console + runbook (ETA 2026-03-24)
  - sana: customer outreach summaries + postmortem comms (ETA 2026-03-18)
  - alice: schedule postmortem meeting and coordinate invites (ETA 2026-03-12)
alice: Also add follow-ups: add metric for per-request KV hit-rate, add alert when kv_miss_rate > 15% AND batch_latency > baseline.
charlie: I'll file tickets in tracker: RINF-1423 KV cache invalidation, RINF-1424 quantization rollout gate, RINF-1425 runbook automate-evict.
bob: Quick notes for postmortem: suspected triage path: quantized kernel change -> subtle key serialization difference -> cache lookup misses -> cache growth + GC pressure -> batching amplifies retries -> spike in 5xx. Need to validate serialization hypothesis.
alice: Great. I'll close the bridge once postmortem is scheduled. Leave batching disabled on pool-23 and keep routing pinned until charlie gives go-ahead.
support-bot: Customer bulletin updated: "We are continuing to monitor. The majority of traffic is healthy; we will follow up with a postmortem and direct outreach to affected customers." :white_check_mark:
alice: Thanks everyone. Marking incident as mitigated (severity reduced). Moving to post-incident follow-up tracking. Thread will be used to collect postmortem notes and action item status.
charlie: Noted. I'll update RINF tickets as work progresses and ping when patches land.
bob: Uploading logs and a reproduction harness to the postmortem doc now.
alice: Closing active paging loop. On-call handoff to night team: @dave will be primary; alice will be secondary. Handoff timestamp: 1778892300.
dave: Acknowledged. Keeping an eye overnight.
